title: How Do I Get Closer To You? 🙏

bible.text: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... how do I get closer to You when I keep messing up the same way?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I pray, then I fail again by night. Feels like I don't even deserve to talk to You.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Closeness was never about being clean first. It's about showing up anyway.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But every time I pray after failing, I feel like a hypocrite.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A hypocrite stops caring. You're still here, still asking. That's not fake -- that's faith fighting through shame.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So what, I just keep failing and keep praying?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You keep coming back. Closeness isn't a finish line you reach -- it's a direction you keep walking.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe you were never too far. Maybe you just stopped believing you could come back.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: If you're tired of running and ready to come back today, drop a 🙏 below.
